type.doc: Choose the type of the object.

value.doc: Choose the value assigned to the object.

dimensions.doc: Physical dimensions of the field: [kg m s K mol A cd].

internalField.doc: Initial value of the field in the domain interior.

boundaryField.doc: Boundary conditions of the field, one sub-dictionary per patch.

uniform.doc: Marks a field value that is constant in space.

libs.doc: Additional shared-object libraries to load at solver start.

application.doc: The solver this case is set up for.

startFrom.doc: Where to pick the simulation start time from.

startTime.doc: Start time of the simulation (used with startFrom startTime).

endTime.doc: End time of the simulation (used with stopAt endTime).

purgeWrite.doc: Keep only the most recent N time directories (0 keeps all).

timePrecision.doc: Significant figures in time directory names.

runTimeModifiable.doc: Re-read dictionaries at the start of each time step.

adjustTimeStep.doc: Let the solver adapt deltaT to honour maxCo.

maxCo.doc: Maximum Courant number when adjustTimeStep is active.

maxDeltaT.doc: Upper bound on the adapted time step.

graphFormat.doc: Output format for function object graphs.

OptimisationSwitches.doc: Compiler optimization level and related switches.

default.doc: Fallback scheme applied when no specific entry matches.

method.doc: Wall distance computation method (meshWave or Poisson).

fluxRequired.doc: Specifies which fields require explicit flux definitions.

solvers.doc: Linear solver settings, one sub-dictionary per matrix/field.

tolerance.doc: Absolute residual at which the linear solve stops.

relTol.doc: Relative residual reduction at which the linear solve stops (0 disables).

PISO.doc: Settings for the PISO pressure-velocity coupling loop.

SIMPLE.doc: Settings for the SIMPLE steady-state coupling loop.

PIMPLE.doc: Settings for the merged PISO-SIMPLE coupling loop.

relaxationFactors.doc: Under-relaxation factors for fields and equations.

residualControl.doc: Convergence criteria for SIMPLE/PIMPLE outer loops.

nOuterCorrectors.doc: Number of outer loop corrector iterations in PIMPLE.

momentumPredictor.doc: Perform momentum prediction step before pressure correction.

minIter.doc: Minimum iterations per time step for solvers.

maxIter.doc: Maximum iterations per time step for solvers.

cacheAgglomeration.doc: Cache agglomerated matrix for GAMG acceleration.

nPreSweeps.doc: Number of pre-smoothing sweeps in GAMG.

nPostSweeps.doc: Number of post-smoothing sweeps in GAMG.

mergeLevels.doc: Number of matrix levels merged in GAMG hierarchy.

convertToMeters.doc: Scaling factor applied to all vertex coordinates.

scale.doc: Scaling factor applied to all vertex coordinates (newer name).

blocks.doc: Hex block definitions: vertex ordering, cell counts, grading.

boundary.doc: Boundary patches: name, type and face lists.

mergePatchPairs.doc: Pairs of patches to merge into internal faces.

numberOfSubdomains.doc: How many processors to decompose the case for.

preservePatches.doc: Patches to keep on a single processor (e.g. cyclics).

n.doc: Number of subdomains in each direction (x y z).

scotchCoeffs.doc: Coefficients for Scotch graph decomposition method.

distributed.doc: Distribute decomposition across processors during writing.

roots.doc: Preferred root processor indices for decomposition.

RAS.doc: Settings for Reynolds-Averaged Navier-Stokes turbulence modelling.

LES.doc: Settings for Large-Eddy Simulation turbulence modelling.

printCoeffs.doc: Print turbulence model coefficients at each time step.

delta.doc: Sub-grid length scale calculation method for LES.

type.doc: Boundary condition type for this patch.

inletValue.doc: Value used on inflow for inletOutlet boundary condition.

freestreamValue.doc: Freestream value for inletOutlet-type boundary conditions.

refValue.doc: Reference value for mixed boundary conditions.

refGradient.doc: Reference gradient for mixed boundary conditions.

valueFraction.doc: Weighting factor between value and gradient in mixed boundary conditions.

gradient.doc: Gradient value for fixedGradient boundary conditions.

phi.doc: Name of the flux field used by the boundary condition (default: phi).

rho.doc: Name of the density field for compressible flows.

gamma.doc: Blending factor for stability in inlet boundary conditions.

p0.doc: Reference pressure for totalPressure boundary condition.

U.doc: Velocity field name or value in boundary conditions.

castellatedMesh.doc: Enable castellated mesh generation from CAD geometry.

snap.doc: Enable snapping of mesh to surface features.

addLayers.doc: Enable addition of boundary layers near surfaces.

castellatedMeshControls.doc: Parameters controlling the castellated mesh generation.

maxLocalCells.doc: Maximum number of cells per CPU-local processor before subdivision.

maxGlobalCells.doc: Maximum number of cells in the mesh (stop if exceeded).

minRefinementCells.doc: Minimum number of cells to refine before splitting into branches.

nCellsBetweenLevels.doc: Number of buffer cells between refinement levels.

features.doc: Feature edge extraction settings and file references.

locationInMesh.doc: Point inside the mesh region to be refined (inside domain).

allowFreeStandingZoneFaces.doc: Allow zone faces not covered by surface (for multi-region meshes).

snapControls.doc: Parameters controlling the surface snapping phase.

nSmoothPatch.doc: Number of mesh smoothing iterations on patches during snapping.

tolerance.doc: Relative distance tolerance for snapping to surface.

nSolveIter.doc: Number of iterations of the surface solver during snapping.

nRelaxIter.doc: Number of relaxation iterations during snapping.

addLayersControls.doc: Parameters controlling the boundary layer addition phase.

relativeSizes.doc: Interpret layer thickness relative to local cell size.

expansionRatio.doc: Growth ratio of boundary layer thickness from wall outward.

finalLayerThickness.doc: Thickness of the outermost layer in the boundary layer stack.

minThickness.doc: Minimum thickness for boundary layers (stop if not achievable).

nGrow.doc: Number of layers of cells to grow into the domain.

featureAngle.doc: Angle threshold in degrees for detecting edges as feature lines.

nRelaxIter.doc: Number of smoothing iterations on layer normals.

nSmoothSurfaceNormals.doc: Number of smoothing iterations on patch-face normals.

maxConcave.doc: Maximum concavity of faces in degrees.

minVol.doc: Minimum cell volume (relative to bounding box).

defaultFieldValues.doc: Default field values applied to the entire domain.

boxToCell.doc: Select cells within an axis-aligned box.

zoneToCell.doc: Select cells belonging to a named zone.
